summary: All 5 fix_tasks genuinely closed: intrinsic epoch check reads target file before mutation; comments didactic; no English tokens; constant reused; budget amendment justified.
notes: Second-pass review of git diff 50997cc..03cb1d0 (fix commit) against the 5 fix_tasks recorded by the first reviewer.

Fix 1 (per_class budget): 02-contract.yaml crates/hexcell/tests/** widened 90->130 with a dated, written rationale in a comment explaining the 90 was a pre-code estimate and the 117 actual lines are the sole async-orchestration coverage of HEX-056's ruta_del_archivo precondition. Verified crates/hexcell/tests/promocion.rs was NOT modified by the fix commit (untouched, confirmed via diff) and its added test genuinely exercises revertir_epoca_de_conocimiento + drenar_epoca_superseida_de_conocimiento end to end, asserting the HEX-056 precondition. This is legitimate right-sizing, not goalpost-moving: the new ceiling (130) still leaves margin above the actual usage (117), so it was not reverse-fitted to the exact number.

Fix 2 (intrinsic epoch number, the substantive one): revertir_a_epoca now calls conocimiento::inspeccionar_base_en_sombra (reused, not a parallel reader) as its new step 4, strictly before the self-supersede canonicalize check (step 5), before opening any pool (step 10, abrir_sobre) and before the symlink reassignment (step 11). Verified by reading the diff line order and by tracing inspeccionar_base_en_sombra's query_row: a missing metadatos_de_epoca row maps to None via QueryReturnedNoRows, and the match arm `Some(n) if n == numero_destino => n, _ => reject` routes both None and any mismatched Some into rejection, never a silent pass. The rejection path returns Ok(Rechazada) immediately with no fs mutation, and the reported numero_de_epoca in the success arm is numero_confirmado (the value read from the file), not the caller's numero_destino. New test verificar_reversion_rechaza_numero_de_epoca_intrinseco_discrepante mutates the target file's internal number via direct SQL UPDATE, asserts NumeroDeEpocaIntrinsecoDiscrepante{numero_solicitado, numero_leido}, and asserts inertia (symlink unchanged, both files still exist). Ran `cargo test -p hexcell-storage --test reversion`: 10/10 pass including this new test.

Fix 3 (didactic comments): traced every renumbered comment (old 3,5,6,9,10,11 -> new 3,5,6,9,10,11,12 after the step-4 insertion) individually; each now states a WHY rationale (e.g. step 9 explains reusing the already-canonical variable to avoid recanonicalizing after the filesystem is about to mutate; step 11 cites D-29 and explains why rename is chosen over unlink+symlink) instead of restating the following line. The two rationales previously dropped from the promover_epoca-derived block are both restored verbatim in spirit: the two-sided NFR-03 liveness assertion rationale, and the f64::INFINITY sentinel rationale.

Fix 4 (English tokens): grepped the full worktree for GUARD, self-supersede, bare swap (excluding ArcSwap) and re-promotion/rollback - zero hits outside the one pre-approved exception '(reversion o *rollback*)' in adr-0026. Confirms the orchestrator's own sweep of the three tokens it flagged in adr-0026 (GUARD 3/4, antes del swap) also landed cleanly.
Fix 5 (constant reuse): CONTEO_ESPERADO_DE_METADATOS_DE_CONOCIMIENTO is now pub(crate) in promocion.rs, imported and used in reversion.rs's debug_assert_eq!, replacing the hardcoded 0.

No new defect found in the fix commit. Independent spot checks: cargo fmt --check clean, cargo clippy --workspace -D warnings clean, cargo test -p hexcell-storage --test reversion 10/10 pass, cargo test -p hexcell --test promocion (reversion+drain orchestration test) 1/1 pass. hexcell-storage/src/reversion.rs and conocimiento.rs contain no tokio/async fn/.await (executor-free invariant holds).
